faq.question: Can I upload large datasets to the CSV Splitter?
faq.answer: Yes. This tool is designed to utilize browser-based memory to handle large file uploads securely.

faq.question: Is my confidential business data secure?
faq.answer: Absolutely. All processing occurs locally on your machine. Your data is never uploaded to external servers.

faq.question: Why is the interactive table or chart not displaying?
faq.answer: If the tool is in 'Future Ready' mode, it means the advanced visualization engine (like ag-Grid or Chart.js) is pending integration.
